lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Single formed bend of about 89 deg between the L-shaped base plate (outer skin 2) and the narrow upright flange (outer skin 4). In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer arc: the nearest scan point is 0.19/0.23/0.15 mm away, and the label is within about 0.2 mm of the arc mid-apex (expected outer apex offset 3.31 mm vs fitted 3.23). The line is parallel to the fold (apex height drift is 0.1 mm over 16.6 mm). It spans the full fold width, from the relief slit edge to the flange's free edge (16.6 mm, coverage 1.0); the close-up from outside the bend confirms it runs edge to edge. Sections every 2 mm along the line show a consistent arc profile. Patch 12 (16 deg facet) lies on this same outer arc near the flange tangent (e1 about -1.8, e2 about -3 mm in the section frame), so it is part of B1 and not a separate bend.
